title: Our Citizenship Is in Heaven
speaker: Ryan Baird
summary: Forget the bucket list. Long for heaven in a way that makes you live a focused, even dangerous life here, and finish with a muddy jersey.
exhortation: I don't believe in bucket lists. I don't think that in the new heavens and the new earth I'll look back and say, "I wish I'd visited the Great Wall of China, or gone to Hawaii, or gotten that dream house." Those things aren't bad. I just don't think they're a big deal.

As Christians, we should be longing, even groaning, for heaven in a way that makes us live a focused, even dangerous life here. We should be imagining and even daydreaming about the next life, and not just heaven, but the return of our Savior Jesus, who will come in power and make all things right.

Rest and vacations are important, but with the mindset of getting back into the game and back to work. I don't want to enter heaven toned and tan. I want to arrive battle-scarred, with my jersey muddy and bloody. How embarrassing to reach the end of life with a clean jersey. This life isn't for taking it easy. It's for leaving it all on the field. We don't need to save anything for later. We can't take it with us, and what lies ahead is so much better it isn't even comparable.

What's important in this life is people: the people we love, and the people who need the gospel. That's our mission. And what's important is pleasing our Savior Jesus. As 2 Corinthians 5:1-2 says, "For we know that if the tent that is our earthly home is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. For in this tent we groan, longing to put on our heavenly dwelling." What a great promise for those in Christ.
prayer: Lord, someone who lives for heaven finds that his earthly purpose becomes stronger, more fixed and more sure. Set our eyes on things above, on our great and mighty Savior who has conquered and is reigning and ruling. Fill us with strength and confidence.

Help us see clearly what is pulling us into this world's mindset and away from a heavenly one. Help us be salty Christians with a radical and strange distaste for this world, because we belong to another. Help us live our lives fully and radically for you, Lord Jesus. Amen.
